spec_match.rationale: Uses throwing-getter observation on the WebTransport options dictionary to determine which members this build reads — with serverCertificateHashes as the positive control — plus a prototype inventory locating responseHeaders, the exact detectability contract of dictionary-carried features.

interactive.rationale: Auto-runs with a rerun button; verified the member table, the control row firing, and the prototype inventory (9 members, responseHeaders absent) all rendered from live probes.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises synchronous, no-server detection via getters, which is what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: The control member proves the technique, long-documented-but-unimplemented members (allowPooling) demonstrate that 'not read' describes the binary rather than the spec, and the detail says so explicitly.

conformance.rationale: The suite's options-dictionary-read, undeclared-members-never-read, headers-member and responseHeaders assertions are these probes; on Chromium 141 it honestly ran 5 pass / 2 fail with exactly the two Chrome-154 assertions failing.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): the probe reported the correct pre-154 shape — serverCertificateHashes read, headers/protocols/allowPooling not read, responseHeaders absent from the 9-member prototype, controls holding; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs member read states per run.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, verdict banner as text plus colour, captioned tables, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Verdict and detail are text/aria-live, tables carry captions and scoped headers, rerun button is 44px.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/webtransport-headers-and-responseheaders/options-probe/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). The getter probe ran live and gave the correct pre-154 verdict — this build does not read options.headers and responseHeaders is not on the prototype — with a working positive control and a genuinely instructive point about 'not read' describing the binary, not the specification. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; no mobile overflow; feature /conformance/ honestly ran 5 pass / 2 fail (the two Chrome-154 assertions). Clears the bar.
